rule: S742 live_concurrency: earliest starts, game_id then ticker order on ties; a row is served only if the focus tickers of the served games whose scheduled-focus window [start - 120 s, start + 3600 s) is open never exceed the focus ticker capacity (anonymous_rate_ceiling x focus_tick_s requests x focus share // 100; soccer 3 tickers a game, other sports 2) and the full request budget (books + selected repoll + half the tickers' trades), with a floor of one game per sport that has a selected game in its window; score-blind, before any start; the profile key maximum_scheduled_games_per_hour declares the default rule only
